question: Which among the following is NOT an extension for a video file?
solution:
The correct answer is __**.jpeg.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• JPEG stands for Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG)
 
• It is a standardized image compression mechanism designed for compressing either full-colour three-band (RGB) or grey-scale one-band images.JPEG stands for Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG)

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• There are 8 common video formats data MP4, MOV, WMV, FLV, AVI, AVCHD, WebM, and MKV.
 
• The video format is the container that stores audio-video subtitles and any other metadata. 
 
• A codec encodes and decodes the multimedia data such as audio or video. 
 
• A QT file is a movie file saved in the QuickTime File Format (QTFF), which is a multimedia container format developed by Apple.
